spotlight.title: 100 Facts About Axolotl
spotlight.subtitle: The Eternal Toddler
spotlight.description: A salamander that never grows up, can regrow its own brain, and holds secrets scientists are only beginning to unlock. 100 jaw-dropping facts.

books.title: 100 Facts About Mantis Shrimp
books.subtitle: The Rainbow Assassin
books.description: It punches with the force of a bullet, sees colors humans can't imagine, and creates underwater explosions hotter than the surface of the sun. Meet the most biologically outrageous creature in the ocean — 100 jaw-dropping facts about nature's ultimate warrior.

books.title: 100 Facts About Capybaras
books.subtitle: The Zen Master of the Animal Kingdom
books.description: The world's largest rodent convinced crocodiles to use it as a sofa. 100 mind-blowing facts about nature's most lovable giant.

books.title: 100 Facts About Tardigrades
books.subtitle: The Unthinkable Tiny Titan
books.description: They survive in volcanoes, outer space, and mass extinctions. 100 incredible facts about the most indestructible creature on Earth.

books.title: 100 Facts About Platypuses
books.subtitle: An Evolutionary Fever Dream
books.description: Part duck, part beaver, part otter — and it hunts with electricity. 100 wild facts about the animal that broke every rule of biology.

books.title: 100 Facts About Immortal Jellyfish
books.subtitle: The Jellyfish That Refused to Die
books.description: The only known animal that can revert to its juvenile state and live forever. 100 stunning facts about the jellyfish that broke mortality.

books.title: 100 Facts About Narwhals
books.subtitle: The Unicorn of the Deep
books.description: That spiral tusk is actually a tooth packed with millions of nerve endings. 100 extraordinary facts about the ocean's most mythical creature.

books.title: 100 Facts About Orcas
books.subtitle: The Ocean's Apex in Black and White
books.description: They hunt great white sharks for sport and have complex family cultures passed down through generations. 100 powerful facts.

books.title: 100 Facts About Pangolins
books.subtitle: The Articulated Artichoke
books.description: The world's most trafficked mammal is also one of its most mysterious. 100 remarkable facts about the only mammal covered in scales.

books.title: 100 Facts About Quokkas
books.subtitle: The World's Happiest Animal
books.description: Always smiling, always unbothered — this tiny marsupial has taken the internet by storm. 100 delightful facts about Australia's most cheerful resident.

books.title: 100 Facts About Octopuses
books.subtitle: The Eight-Armed Alien of the Sea
books.description: Three hearts, blue blood, and a brain in every arm. 100 mind-bending facts about the most intelligent invertebrate on Earth.

books.title: 100 Facts About Sloths
books.subtitle: The Art of Doing Nothing
books.description: So slow that algae grows on their fur — and that's actually their superpower. 100 surprisingly fascinating facts about the world's most unhurried animal.

books.title: 100 Facts About Komodo Dragons
books.subtitle: The Last Living Dragon
books.description: The world's largest lizard hunts with venom, bacteria, and terrifying patience. 100 fierce facts about the closest thing to a real dragon.

books.title: 100 Facts About Snow Leopards
books.subtitle: The Ghost of the Mountains
books.description: So elusive it was considered mythical for centuries. 100 breathtaking facts about the most mysterious big cat on Earth.

books.title: 100 Facts About Manta Rays
books.subtitle: The Ocean's Silent Giant
books.description: With a wingspan wider than a car and a brain bigger than any fish, the manta ray is the ocean's most graceful genius. 100 stunning facts.

books.title: 100 Facts About Giant Squids
books.subtitle: The Monster of the Deep
books.description: Eyes the size of basketballs, arms lined with razor-sharp suckers, never fully seen alive until 2004. 100 terrifying facts about the ocean's greatest mystery.

books.title: 100 Facts About Secretary Birds
books.subtitle: The Bird That Hunts Like a Ninja
books.description: A bird that stomps snakes to death with kicks powerful enough to break bones. 100 extraordinary facts about Africa's most striking raptor.

books.title: 100 Facts About Blobfish
books.subtitle: The Ugliest Survivor
books.description: It's not actually ugly — that's just what happens when you bring a deep sea creature to the surface. 100 surprisingly fascinating facts.

books.title: 100 Facts About Leafy Sea Dragons
books.subtitle: The Camouflage Kings
books.description: Part plant, part animal, entirely magical. 100 breathtaking facts about the most beautiful and bizarre creature in the sea.

books.title: 100 Facts About Star-Nosed Moles
books.subtitle: The Star-Faced Digger
books.description: With 22 pink tentacles on its face and the fastest eating speed of any mammal, this creature is pure biological madness. 100 wild facts.

books.title: 100 Facts About Mimic Octopuses
books.subtitle: The Master of Disguise
books.description: It can impersonate over 15 different species on demand. 100 astonishing facts about the ocean's most cunning shape-shifter.

books.title: 100 Facts About Pistol Shrimp
books.subtitle: The Fastest Gun in the Ocean
books.description: A shrimp that creates a bubble hotter than the sun with a snap of its claw. 100 explosive facts about the ocean's smallest but deadliest hunter.

books.title: 100 Facts About Flying Squirrels
books.subtitle: The Flying Rodent
books.description: They don't actually fly — they glide up to 300 feet through the night sky. 100 soaring facts about nature's ultimate daredevil.

books.title: 100 Facts About Honey Badgers
books.subtitle: The Fearless Chaos Machine
books.description: It attacks lions, survives snake venom, and escapes every enclosure ever built for it. 100 fearless facts about nature's toughest animal.

books.title: 100 Facts About Peacocks
books.subtitle: The King of Colors
books.description: Those iridescent feathers contain no blue or green pigment — it's pure physics creating the color. 100 dazzling facts about the world's most spectacular bird.
